title: THE LOCKDOWN ALARM IS GONE
why: His order of 2026-10-14: get rid of the sealed lockdown thing, that is a mess. The lockdown alarm raid event, which sealed a ring of ground for a minute with a cache in the middle and made the machines inside berserk, is removed completely: it is out of the event pool, so no raid plans it, and its fences with their collision, its lockdown cache, its callouts (SEALED IN, DISTRICT SEALED, DOORS OPEN, LOCKDOWN OVER), its marks on the minimap and the map, and everything player 2 was told about it are gone. The other five events stay (orbital debris, machine convoy, bounty pillager, coolant rupture, Overseer rampage), still one or two a raid, drawn on the same event stream so nothing else that is seeded moves. The older checks that staged the lockdown now report that it was taken out.
now: The lockdown alarm event is gone: no more sealed rings.
